description: Async client code and the watchers that answer it: a pre watcher whose flag cancels out around an await, beside a post watcher, a watchEffect and a handler that awaits nextTick; two awaited assignments in one function; a guard after a change; a loop that awaits; a local async function's promise chained and held; writes after a try whose block and catch return; a watcher calling a function that reassigns its parameter. Every reply comes from a button.
